say:1:1041576701:1.text: Lamentis! Do you have any idea how much work went into that city?!
say:1:1041576701:1.source_cn: 拉曼提斯！那座小城可是我精心准备了整整半个月的绝佳剧场！

say:2:1041576702:1.text: It was my art! My life's work! My absolute fountain of joy! And you... you just ruined it!
say:2:1041576702:1.source_cn: 是我的艺术品！我的心血！我快乐的源泉！现在全都被你毁了！

say:3:1041576703:1.text: I spent two whole weeks cutting off the city's supplies, then disguised myself as a courier to feed them lies that the Empire had abandoned them.
say:3:1041576703:1.source_cn: 我花了整整半个月的时间切断了城市的物资补给，又伪装成信...

say:4:1041576704:1.text: Every night, I had their own shadows whisper into their ears, magnifying every soldier's suspicion and fear...
say:4:1041576704:1.source_cn: 接着，我每天晚上让他们的影子对着他们窃窃私语，放大每一...

say:5:1041576705:1.text: I was seconds away from the payoff! The commander was this close to gutting his beloved lieutenant! The soldiers were about to claw each other apart over crumbs!
say:5:1041576705:1.source_cn: 就在他们的指挥官精神失常，要拿刀砍向他最信任的副官，士...

say:6:1041576706:1.text: The symphony was about to begin! That sweet, delicious choir of absolute human collapse...
say:6:1041576706:1.source_cn: 那种被绝望逼到了极点、人性彻底崩塌的甜美惨叫声马上就要...

say:7:1041576707:1.text: Then YOU! You came along and just blew the entire city off the map!
say:7:1041576707:1.source_cn: 你——竟然把整座城市都炸平了！

say:9:1041576709:1.text: It was too slow. Too boring. Watching you work was making my head hurt.
say:9:1041576709:1.source_cn: 太慢了，太无聊了，看得小爷脑子疼。

say:10:1041576710:1.text: It's called dramatic tension! Proper buildup!
say:10:1041576710:1.source_cn: 这叫戏剧的张力！这叫完美的铺垫！

say:11:1041576711:1.text: Watching self-righteous humans turn on each other out of paranoia, don't you see?! That's ten thousand times more artistic than some dumb explosion!
say:11:1041576711:1.source_cn: 看着自诩正义的人类在猜忌中亲手把刀刺进同伴的胸膛，这难...

say:13:1041576713:1.text: They were taking forever. I just sped things up and turned them all to ash.
say:13:1041576713:1.source_cn: 既然他们磨磨唧唧的，小爷我就帮他们一把，直接让他们一起...

say:14:1041576714:1.text: Wow... what a spectacularly tasteless finale.
say:14:1041576714:1.source_cn: 哇哦……真是一场毫无品味的谢幕。

say:15:1041576715:1.text: Keep whining and I'll turn you into ash too.
say:15:1041576715:1.source_cn: 再废话，下一个变成灰的就是你。

say:16:1041576716:1.text: Honestly, in this entire world, the most unpredictable chaos is that total lack of logic inside your skull!
say:16:1041576716:1.source_cn: 看来在这个世界上，最不可预测的混沌，永远是你那颗毫无逻...

say:17:1041576717:1.text: Fine. I'm going to find a new stage. And don't you dare follow me!
say:17:1041576717:1.source_cn: 我得去找下一个舞台了，你可别跟过来哦！
